upgrades.title: Filter party-statement payments by FY and calculate an explicit opening balance from transactions before the requested period; add a multi-year regression test.
Restrict the global integrity repair so it cannot rebuild accounting journals or stock movements inside a closed financial year without an explicit owner-approved recovery workflow.

Make financial-year backup exports complete and explicit: include purchases, expenses, notes, stock, audit, jobs, bank rows, and GSTR data, or clearly label the export as organization-wide rather than FY-scoped.
Add backup retention, off-device replication, restore drills, disk-space alarms, and verification reporting; daily full backups otherwise grow without a defined retention limit.
Paginate and set-optimize stock, ageing, invoice-status, party-statement, account-ledger, and bank-report endpoints before long-lived databases grow beyond normal operating volume.
Strengthen financial-year close with immutable signed snapshots, carry-forward records, controlled reopen approval, and an auditable forced-close workflow.
Move accounting amounts from floating-point REAL/Number values to integer paise or validated decimal arithmetic before repeated multi-year aggregation and reposting can accumulate rounding drift.
Replace silent additive migration failures with versioned transactional migrations and post-migration validation for long-lived customer databases.
Schedule this isolated audit weekly and retain only its JSON/Markdown reports; alert the owner when a reconciliation or integrity check fails.
Add a financial-year archive and reporting policy before real data exceeds the operational query limits; keep all statutory records and backups intact.
Run the existing 100k/million-row benchmarks and a 24-hour multi-device pilot on the target hardware before certifying throughput or concurrent upload capacity.
